## Before you submit

- [ ] I have signed the Flowamaz CLA (the CLA Assistant bot asks on your first pull request).
- [ ] CI passes.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`type(scope): description`).

> **How your change lands:** this repository is published from Flowamaz's development repository. When your pull request is accepted, a maintainer applies it there, keeping you as the author. It comes back here with the next export, and this pull request is closed with a link to it. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
